q: The passive of “The news shocked him.” is ___
o: He was shocked by the news
He was shocked at the news
He was shocked with the news
He was shocked on the news
e: কিছু ক্রিয়ার passive-এ by-এর বদলে অন্য preposition বসে। Shock, surprise, please, astonish জাতীয় ক্রিয়ায় অনুভূতির কারণ বোঝাতে সাধারণত at বসে, তাই “He was shocked at the news” (খবরটি শুনে সে ধাক্কা খেল)। By বসালে ব্যাকরণগতভাবে ভুল নয়, তবে পরীক্ষায় এই ধরনের ক্রিয়ায় at-ই প্রচলিত উত্তর। একই রকম: surprised at, pleased with, annoyed with।

q: Choose the correct passive form of the sentence: 'She is cooking dinner.'
o: Dinner was cooked by her.
Dinner is being cooked by her.
Dinner is cooked by her.
Dinner has been cooked by her.
e:
The sentence is in the present continuous tense. To change a present continuous active sentence into the passive, we use 'is/am/are + being + past participle'. The object 'dinner' becomes the subject, so we get 'Dinner is being cooked by her.' The other options change the tense, which a voice change must never do.
মনে রাখুন:
Present continuous: am/is/are + being + V3
Past continuous: was/were + being + V3
Present perfect: has/have + been + V3

q: 'The work is done by Maruf' This is an example of-
o: active voice
passive voice
not any voice which are mentioned
quasi -passive voice
e: The work is done by Maruf বাক্যটি passive voice, কারণ এখানে কাজটি (the work) subject, আর কর্তা Maruf by দিয়ে পরে এসেছে। গঠনটি be verb (is) + past participle (done), যা passive voice-এর চিহ্ন। এর active রূপ: Maruf does the work। Quasi-passive হলো এমন বাক্য যার গঠন active কিন্তু অর্থ passive, যেমন Honey tastes sweet বা The book sells well। তাই বাক্যটি quasi-passive নয়, আর 'কোনো voice নয়' অপশনও ভুল।

q: Select the correct passive voice of ‘I knew him’.
o: He was known by me.
He was known with me.
He was known to me.
he is known to me.
e: Know ক্রিয়ার passive-এ by নয়, to বসে, তাই I knew him হবে He was known to me। Active বাক্যটি past simple, তাই passive-এ was + past participle (known) বসেছে, আর object him হয়েছে subject he। 'He was known by me' প্রচলিত শুদ্ধ রূপ নয়, 'known with' ভুল, আর 'He is known to me' কাল বদলে present করে ফেলেছে। কিছু verb-এর passive-এ by-এর বদলে অন্য preposition বসে, যেমন pleased with, surprised at, interested in, filled with।
